text:
maria: launching quick three-way preflight for the API/runtime/console/router bundle — change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. pinging @alex @ben for router header swap dependency. release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/2026-03/threeway-bundle

alex: ack. i reviewed the diff. console has a minor schema tweak but no DB migration. runtime needs the new batching kernel, already baked as runtime:v2.3. router header swap is the one blocking pin for me.

ben: router header swap will be done via header-split flag flip. no rollout migration needed. plan: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% with 10m soak each.

maria: deploy-bot, please schedule canary at 02:05 UTC and pin API/runtime/console to the v2.3 set. router to be traffic-shifted with header-split tag.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 1769996660 at 02:05 UTC. will post pin + traffic-shift events. keeper: @maria will hold final GO.

sam: quick Q on rollback criteria — do we use the usual: error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3 mins OR 2x latency p50 from baseline?

alex: yes. add one more: KV cache miss rate > 20% or OOM spikes on runtime pods. if any of those hit during canary, auto-run rollback and pin older model variant.

ben: noted. fallback model variants pinned: api:v2.2, runtime:q8-v2.2, console:v2.2. router will route back to header-old variant on rollback.

maria: putting the checklist here. folks, reply with :thumbsup: when you have ownership for the step.
- preflight logs uploaded
- canary scheduled
- pin configs prepared
- runbook added to release notes
- post-canary perf hooks set

alex: preflight logs uploaded ✅

ben: pin configs: saved in /ops/pins/1769996660-pin.json. snippet to pin router variant:
```bash
curl -X POST https://orch.internal/pin -d '{"service":"router","variant":"header-split-v1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ORCH'
```

sam: runbook added to release notes under Troubleshooting -> Rollback. added exact alert names and runbook IDs.

deploy-bot: canary started at 02:05 UTC — 10% traffic to header-split-v1. monitoring: perf, errors, kv-miss, oom.

maria: monitoring dashboards are green so far. keep eyes on p95 and kv-miss.

deploy-bot: canary advanced to 50% at 02:15 UTC after no alerts.

alex: saw a small p95 blip at 02:18, but recovered. not hitting thresholds.

ben: router logs look fine. no header mismatch errors.

deploy-bot: canary completed to 100% at 02:25 UTC. pins applied: api:v2.3, runtime:v2.3, console:v2.3, router:header-split-v1.

sam: post-canary sanity: p50/p95/kv-miss within expected ranges. rolling post-deploy perf check at +10m.

maria: excellent. final step — update released-by line and close the change window. @alex can you merge the small console config note into the release notes?

alex: on it, PR merged. closing window at 02:58 UTC. great job team :tada:

ben: +1. will keep an eye on the next 12h.

maria: thanks all. leaving the runbook for oncall. if any regression, we'll follow rollback flow above.
